submitted.rationale: Composition 0 (Cu 0.79) gave the highest measured EQE, 2.2e-4 %. EQE rose steadily with Cu content: 0 at Cu 0.32, 6.9e-5 % at Cu 0.67, 2.2e-4 % at Cu 0.79. XRD shows single-phase CuSb2O6 near Cu 0.32 and no activity there. At Cu 0.73 the XRD shows a different, Cu-rich phase mixture. The activity comes from the Cu-rich end, and index 0 is the most Cu-rich composition in the library.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE of 6.9e-5 %, about 3x lower than index 0.
Sb-rich Sb-oxide phases (XRD). Not measured; the trend points away from the Sb-rich end.
